subject: general
question: When a wire is bent in the form of a square, then the area enclosed by it is 5929 cm². If wire is bent into the form of a circle, then what will be the area enclosed by the wire?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of **square** = √5929 = 77 cm.

Length of **wire** (Perimeter) = 4 × 77 = 308 cm.

For a **circle** with circumference 308 cm, radius (r) = 308 × 7 ÷ 44 = 49 cm.

**Area of circle** = (22/7) × 49 × 49 = 154 × 49 = 7546 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 7546 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Area of the square = 5929 cm².

**Formula Used:** Area of square = side²; Perimeter = 4 × side; Circumference of circle = 2πr; Area of circle = πr².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27af80d97a98a363ca922183a4efac904da44da68217e31b2ce85dfacb4dc6c6.png] 

⇒ **Side of square** (a) = √5929 = 77 cm.

⇒ **Length of wire** = Perimeter of square = 4 × 77 = 308 cm.

⇒ **Circumference of circle** = 308 cm.

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 308.

⇒ (44/7) × r = 308.

⇒ r = (308 × 7) ÷ 44 = 49 cm.

⇒ **Area of circle** = πr² = (22/7) × 49 × 49.

⇒ Area = 22 × 7 × 49 = 154 × 49 = 7546 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 7546 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perimeter Invariance

When a wire is bent from one shape to another, the **total length** (perimeter) of the wire remains constant.

Circle Properties

The relationship between circumference (C) and area (A) is A = C² / (4π).

Square vs Circle Area

For a fixed perimeter, a **circle** encloses a larger area than a square or any other polygon.</p
